title: Programme Brief — conveyor buildout (retrospective, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Programme Brief — conveyor buildout

The programme-level brief for conveyor buildout, derived from the live programme and MSP record. In the tables, an em dash (—) marks a field the record does not carry.

## Vision and outcomes

The programme is **conveyor buildout** (id `01a1d039-0d24-7d16-ae52-4841e96ccfac`), status active, created 2026-11-12T14:46:02.275593+00:00, version 1. The programme's outcomes are stated by seven benefit profiles.

| Ref | Description | Category | Objective | Observable outcome | Target | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | Auditable decisions | governance | every choice has a decision row | — | every choice has a decision row | active |
| B2 | Less bespoke tooling | programme benefit | O4 Every tool is governed | Every cluster service a job may call is a versioned, bound, audited toolkit with a ledger. | every service a job uses is a toolkit; a toolkit with no calls in a cycle is retired or justified | draft |
| B3 | Self-development | programme benefit | O5 The conveyor develops and operates itself under its own gates | A development project runs lane -> PR -> CI -> merge -> deploy -> live verify, with rollback, through the conveyor. | one self-development run reaches live verification on evidence; a second is repeatable | draft |
| B4 | Public collaboration | programme benefit | O6 The public can see and challenge the design | An outside reader can read every published output, and an outside issue or PR changes the design. | at least one outside contribution changes a published output; every output is reachable | draft |
| B5 | One model | programme benefit | O1 One model, one store | A concept has one table and one action registry; no concept has two stores. | the T0 gate exists and refuses a second store; the registry has one home | draft |
| B6 | Predictable delivery | delivery | the seed, coverage and published checklist agree | The programme plan's tranches, projects and expected outputs agree with the measured coverage and the published checklist. | the seed, coverage and published checklist agree at every tranche review | active |
| B7 | Tokens per accepted deliverable | efficiency | reduce the token spend per accepted deliverable | fewer inference tokens per demo-credited deliverable without a higher run-failure rate | 20% reduction on the primary denominator (unit: tokens per demo-credited deliverable; value: 504452) | active |

_Source: programme.json#/programme, msp.json#/benefit_profiles_

## Benefit categories

The record holds 7 benefit profiles across the categories delivery (1), efficiency (1), governance (1) and programme benefit (4); statuses are 3 active and 4 draft.

| Ref | Category | Description | Baseline | Target | KPI | Measure | Status |

| B1 | governance | Auditable decisions | 105 approval_decision / 662 run at 2026-11-22 (unit: decisions per run; value: 0.15861) | every choice has a decision row | decisions per run = 0.15861 | Count decision rows per run from the action ledger. | active |
| B2 | programme benefit | Less bespoke tooling | not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project) | every service a job uses is a toolkit; a toolkit with no calls in a cycle is retired or justified | zero-use toolkits retired after a programme cycle (P10) | The tool_call ledger's per-toolkit counts, read at the tranche review; retirement is a decision. | draft |
| B3 | programme benefit | Self-development | not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project) | one self-development run reaches live verification on evidence; a second is repeatable | a development run reaches live verification with a recorded rollback | The development project's run, CI and deploy records; the lane and PR are the evidence. | draft |
| B4 | programme benefit | Public collaboration | not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project) | at least one outside contribution changes a published output; every output is reachable | an outside issue or PR that changes a published output | The GitHub issue registry and merged PR authors; the publications are recorded on the programme issues. | draft |
| B5 | programme benefit | One model | not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project) | the T0 gate exists and refuses a second store; the registry has one home | no concept with two stores (the T0 gate) | The T0 gate test and the absorption inventory; a second store is a defect. | draft |
| B6 | delivery | Predictable delivery | check-registers at /tmp/conveyor-526-reg-snap (unit: open register findings; value: 28.0) | the seed, coverage and published checklist agree at every tranche review | open register findings = 28.0 | coverage.json and seed/programme.json regenerated and checked in CI; the P0 checklist counts the published set. | active |
| B7 | efficiency | Tokens per accepted deliverable | 9,458,468 inference tokens / 15 demo-credited deliverables at 2026-11-22 (unit: tokens per demo-credited deliverable; value: 630565) | 20% reduction on the primary denominator (unit: tokens per demo-credited deliverable; value: 504452) | tokens per demo-credited deliverable; baseline 630565; target 504452; run failure rate; ceiling baseline + 0.5pp | inference ledger total tokens / demo-credited deliverables | active |
